title: Extensions
lightbox:
Period-style extensions

Example two-storey and basement extensions at the rear of a Victorian terraced houses.
Including:

  • bathroom
  • extended kitchen
  • basement storeroom
  • outside access
  • stone window lintels and sills
  • period box sash windows
  • reclaimed stock bricks

To discuss your extension requirements, give Paul a ring on 07973 380780.
You will need to have your plans drawn up, including a structural engineer report,
and passed through building control before any building can occur.

title: Heritage Work
lightbox:
Heritage Work

Traditional carpentry and masonry work for listed buildings, Grades I and II. Some examples are:

17th century timber-framed farm cottage:

  • raising the oak frame
  • replacing the oak framework at ground level
  • extending the brickwork
  • installing a new oak soleplate
  • oak windows
  • oak door with frame
  • stainless steel mesh fixed to frame for stability
  • lime rendered exterior

Timber porch built to suit the listed building including:

  • timber frame structure
  • reclaimed slate roof
  • side windows
  • tongue and groove panelling at 45deg
  • detailed bargeboards in traditional black and white
  • natural stone floor

To enquire about heritage work, contact Paul on 07973 380780
